name: Remove the C++ editor host and its CMake
body: Delete `apps/world-editor/CMakeLists.txt`, `cmake/` (Dependencies.cmake and EditorBackend.cmake, with its Rust backend option), `src/main.cpp`, `src/EditorHost.{h,cpp}` and `src/native/EditorViewportRenderers.{h,cpp}`. The Nox host already does everything they did: `src/main.nox`, `src/EditorFunctions.nox` and `src/ViewportRenderers.nox`.
